policy_680d331344f35db68e62a9cf.exact_text: Every manual-derived predicate must retain its supporting evidence IDs and page provenance. Record origin as MANUAL for OEM conditions and PRODUCT_POLICY for application behavior such as avoiding repeated attempts; policy rules carry their own version and must never be presented as OEM instructions. Relevance tags and rider intent mappings help select candidates, while the reviewed predicates establish applicability. Uncertain interpretation of the rider report remains an unknown observation until clarified.

policy_a582429020c644c2e81622ed.exact_text: When a user reports resolution, close as customer-reported, not mechanically verified

policy_c7c59d8b2e592d93c2827123.exact_text: This specification describes a version-locked, layout-aware multimodal RAG pipeline using only the supplied Royal Enfield New Himalayan 450 owner's manual with diagnostic session state. The LLM may translate a customer report into structured observations and paraphrase manual-backed instructions. No model may author a new repair step absent an applicable evidence object.

policy_dec1ae94d172ff6ececb1329.exact_text: Apply two layers: a deterministic rules gate (valid manual, cited evidence IDs, required dependencies, prerequisites/variant, no explicit conflict) plus a semantic support evaluator that compares each proposed technical claim against relevant source spans. Reject the draft if either layer fails.

policy_e27e55df4b38f7ac71faa0df.exact_text: An action becomes eligible only when the manual and variant match, the rule is approved, the symptom or documented branch applies, required conditions and prerequisites are true, no applicable safety rule prohibits it, and the attempt history allows it. Evaluate the evidence-completeness and answer-release gates separately before issuing technical text. A direct factual lookup uses the same applicability and evidence gates without fabricating a diagnostic step.

policy_e978314f8b1f0dc0999a0ec4.exact_text: The controller selects the response route from structured eligibility decisions, the evidence bundle and gate results. A known applicable stop condition yields SAFETY_STOP and retains its verified warning even if other processing fails. Otherwise, a required component failure yields SYSTEM_ERROR. A resolvable missing applicability fact or documented branch observation yields AMBIGUOUS and one focused question. After bounded recovery, an unsupported request, an unresolved source gap or exhausted documented paths yields UNSUPPORTED with the verified support route.

policy_f196384f650ba83df2a81a1f.exact_text: When the manual lists possible causes or independently documented checks without branch conditions or an explicit next-step order, preserve those limits. Do not infer a condition, eliminate an undocumented branch, diagnose a fault from a negative clue or claim an OEM ranking from retrieval scores. The existing SM-04 policy governs selecting among independently documented eligible checks.

policy_fd0622ee416c74c87cbaf0d6.exact_text: Even a high-scoring semantic verifier can make mistakes; guarantee only that the application follows the fail-closed protocol, not that all semantic classifications are infallible. Output citations must map to immutable evidence object IDs, not model-created page numbers.

Withhold dependent branch; clarify bike/control applicability only through observable question.
One practical source-derived question only if rider-resolvable; source-review gaps route internally or to scoped abstention.
Customer-reported symptom resolution only; other issues and service inspection mandates remain.
Supersede prior observation while preserving attempt history; re-evaluate eligibility without invented order.
